decisions.reason: Close to the established core and cheap to keep, so the option remains valuable with little reason to abandon.
Building on established construction equipment with low uncertainty and low keeping costs, the option stays open.
Distant from the established offer and still without visible value signals after two years, the option has become too costly and unlikely to realize value.
Expanded into a product line from the established offer and shows commitment, so the option is valuable and cheap to keep.
Close to the established offer with strong rental demand and a large order, the option has revealed enough value to keep.
Positive field usage with 1,000 hours and tons moved reduces uncertainty, so the distant option is worth keeping while further value is still resolving.
